revenue.source: Total net sales and revenues, Deere 10-K FY2025 (acc. 0001104659-25-122321) and FY2024 10-K (0001558370-24-016169); FY2023 = total costs 48,232 + pre-tax income 13,019 from FY2023 10-K

operating_income.source: Derived EBIT = Income of consolidated group before income taxes + interest expense (Deere reports no consolidated EBIT line): FY2025 6,257+3,170; FY2024 9,206+3,348; FY2023 13,019+2,453. Includes Financial Services; interest expense of finance arm is added back.

d_and_a.source: Consolidated cash flow statement, depreciation and amortization, FY2025 10-K (0001104659-25-122321); includes depreciation of equipment on operating leases

capex.source: Purchases of property and equipment, consolidated cash flow, FY2025 10-K. Excludes cost of equipment on operating leases acquired (FY2025 2,868).

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 11.7% on trough ag/construction demand; modest FY2026 stabilisation then cyclical recovery toward mid-cycle, fading to 4%. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: derived EBIT margin was 25.3% FY2023, 24.3% FY2024, 20.6% FY2025; use 21% flat (slightly above trough, below peak given tariffs/under-absorption).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US statutory 21%; FY2025 effective 20.1% (1,259/6,257), FY2024 22.7%.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 1,360 / revenue 45,684 = 3.0% (FY2024 3.2%). Note excludes operating-lease equipment purchases while D&A includes lease depreciation, so FCF is likely overstated - reviewer to consider.

wacc.source: Assumption: cyclical industrial, beta ~1.0-1.1, risk-free ~4.2%, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~9.5-10%; after-tax cost of debt ~4%; blended ~9%. Not sourced from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-like growth, below risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: Consolidated balance sheet, FY2025 10-K: short-term borrowings 13,796 + securitization borrowings 6,596 + long-term borrowings 43,544 = 63,936, minus cash 8,276 minus marketable securities 1,411. Includes Financial Services debt, consistent with consolidated EBIT; excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares, millions, FY2025 10-K income statement (0001104659-25-122321)
